Existing action, captured-state, provider-request and owner check records support their stated scope. No application, test, build, probe, validator, SQL, SSH, skill search program or hash execution was performed.

The assigned confirmation case stops at the question and the next case cancels. The retention wording is visibly reviewed, while actual deletion and shared/imported-file preservation after a destructive confirmation are outside this evidence set.

Screenshots do not qualify hidden hit regions, physical input, hardware/sensor behavior, e-ink effects, performance or a live reader lease. No unrelated historical repair or new feature request is asserted.
